description: Defines classes and functions related to various quantizers used in PyTorch, including UnknownQuantizer, UniformQuantizer, NonUniformQuantizer, AffineQuantizer, PerTensorAffineQuantizer, PerChannelAffineQuantizer, and related utility functions for creating and manipulating quantizers and quantized tensors.

classes.name: UnknownQuantizer
classes.description: Placeholder quantizer for a two-step quantization process, inheriting from Quantizer.

classes.name: UniformQuantizer
classes.description: Base class for all uniform quantizers, inheriting from Quantizer.

classes.name: NonUniformQuantizer
classes.description: Base class for all non-uniform quantizers, inheriting from Quantizer.

classes.name: AffineQuantizer
classes.description: Uses affine transformation for quantization, inherits from UniformQuantizer.

classes.name: PerTensorAffineQuantizer
classes.description: Stores a single scale and zero_point for all tensor values, inherits from AffineQuantizer.

classes.name: PerChannelAffineQuantizer
classes.description: Independent scale and zero_point per channel, inherits from AffineQuantizer.

classes.name: PerChannelAffineFloatQParamsQuantizer
classes.description: Per-channel quantizer with floating point zero points, inherits from PerChannelAffineQuantizer.

methods.name: dequantize
methods.description: Performs dequantization on a quantized tensor.

methods.name: dequantize_out
methods.description: Performs dequantization and outputs to a provided tensor.

methods.name: scalar_type
methods.description: Returns the scalar type of the quantizer.

methods.name: get_qtensorimpl
methods.description: Utility to access internal QTensor implementation.

methods.name: new_qtensor
methods.description: Creates a new quantized tensor with specified size, options, and quantizer.

methods.name: set_quantizer_
methods.description: Sets the quantizer for a tensor.

methods.name: from_blob_quantized_per_tensor_affine
methods.description: Creates a quantized tensor from raw data with per-tensor affine quantization.

methods.name: from_blob_quantized_per_channel_affine
methods.description: Creates a quantized tensor from raw data with per-channel affine quantization.
